DAVE WHITCOMB, Valparaiso, Ind. (top photo) was about to be lapped when this picture was taken
in the Sept. 25, 1960, 250 mile late model stock car race here. Coming up on Whitcomb's 1958 Plymouth is Augie
Pabst, Milwaukee, Wis. Whitcomb was red flagged at 222 miles finishing 17th. (Center Row) —A trio of Illinois
speedsters—GIL MICHAELS, Cicero; WILLIAM "WHITEY" GERKEN, Chicago, and BILL SHOULDERS,
Waukegan. Lower row -AUGIE PABST, Milwaukee sports car racer, subbing for Tony Bettenhausen in a
1958 Ford owned by Rodger Ward shows championship form in the Sept. 25, 250 miler here. Doggie Augie,
starting 10th, moved up to fourth spot just past the 130 mile mark, then was forced out with a broken spring
at 176 miles.

TWO FOR TROUBLE
JACK SHANKLIN, like-
able young driver from In-
dianapolis, Ind. (No. 85-1958
Ford convertible) spins on the
15th mile of the July 24, 1960,
200 mile late model stock car
race here. Smacking him is
ED KOZBIEL, Chicago, (No.
33-1958 Ford) and you can see
the hood on Kozbiel's car
buckling under the impact.
Kozbiel was out for good.
Shanklin went on to the pits,
was given a quick check and
continued in the race until
the 122nd mile when the front
axle gave him trouble and he
was forced to quit.
